title: DataSTORM: Deep Research on Large-Scale Databases using Exploratory Data Analysis and Data Storytelling
abstract: arXiv:2604.06474v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Deep research with Large Language Model (LLM) agents is emerging as a powerful paradigm for multi-step information discovery, synthesis, and analysis. However, existing approaches primarily focus on unstructured web data, while the challenges of conducting deep research over large-scale structured databases remain relatively underexplored. Unlike web-based research, effective data-centric research requires more than retrieval and summarization and demands iterative hypothesis generation, quantitative reasoning over structured schemas, and convergence toward a coherent analytical narrative.   In this paper, we present DataSTORM, an LLM-based agentic system capable of autonomously conducting research across both large-scale structured databases and internet sources. translated_title: DataSTORM：基于探索性数据分析与数据叙事的大规模数据库深度研究
translated_abstract: arXiv:2604.06474v2 公告类型：替换版  摘要：基于大型语言模型（LLM）代理的深度研究正成为一种强大的多步骤信息发现、综合与分析范式。然而，现有方法主要集中于非结构化的网络数据，而对大规模结构化数据库进行深度研究时面临的挑战仍未得到充分探索。与基于网络的研究不同，有效的数据中心研究不仅需要检索和摘要，还要求迭代假设生成、对结构化模式的定量推理，以及向连贯分析叙事的收敛。在本文中，我们提出了DataSTORM，一种基于LLM的代理系统，能够自主地在大型结构化数据库和互联网来源中进行研究。基于探索性数据分析和数据叙事的原则，DataSTORM将结构化数据的深度研究重构为一个以论文驱动的分析过程：从假设生成、数据探索、验证到最终叙事构建。
tldr: DataSTORM通过结合探索性数据分析和数据叙事原理，提出了一种基于LLM代理的系统，能够自主对大型结构化数据库进行迭代假设生成、定量推理和叙事收敛，从而克服了传统深度研究仅聚焦于非结构化数据的局限。
en_tdlr: DataSTORM introduces an LLM-based agentic system that integrates exploratory data analysis and data storytelling principles to autonomously conduct iterative hypothesis generation, quantitative reasoning, and narrative convergence over large-scale structured databases, addressing the gap in deep research beyond unstructured web data.
